summary: Fresh build, first test cycle. Backend: 20/20 pytest tests pass covering auth (register/login/logout/me/refresh guards), all 8 assessment types, case CRUD, demo fill for ALL 8 types, report generation for all 8 types, incomplete report guard (400), partial-answers rejection, cross-user isolation. Frontend: landing page renders hero + 10-page grid + 8 assessment types, /auth register→dashboard redirect works, admin login mattsossi@bsossi.com works, logout works, protected routes redirect to /auth. Wizard /new step 1 (type-option-educational) → clicking load-demo-btn-a jumps directly to /report/:id with a full 10-page report. All key testids present: alignment-snapshot, differences-table, action-plan-0, report-page-1..10, next-page-btn, prev-page-btn, page-dot-1..10, print-report-btn, print-container. Print container contains exactly 10 report-page children. Dashboard shows case cards with demo badge, delete works with 'Assessment deleted' toast, count updates.

minor.issue: CORS_ORIGINS='*' combined with allow_credentials=True is an invalid CORS combination per spec; browsers will reject credentialed requests when Access-Control-Allow-Origin is '*'. Currently works only because the frontend is same-origin with the backend under /api. If a different origin ever calls the API with cookies, it will silently fail. Recommend setting CORS_ORIGINS to the explicit preview URL.

action_items: Optional: tighten CORS_ORIGINS in /app/backend/.env to the specific preview origin instead of '*' since allow_credentials=True is set.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py CORS: allow_credentials=True combined with wildcard origin ('*') violates the CORS spec — cookies won't be sent by browsers from cross-origin callers. Works today only because frontend is same-origin.
server.py uses deprecated FastAPI @app.on_event('startup'/'shutdown') hooks — consider migrating to lifespan handlers to avoid deprecation warnings on newer FastAPI versions.

login_attempts lockout: locked_until is refreshed on every failed attempt (upsert $set). This is fine but means the lockout window slides forward with every attempt during a brute-force attack — acceptable, just note it.

get_current_user reads Authorization Bearer as a fallback but set_auth_cookies uses samesite='none' + secure=True. Any local/HTTP dev without HTTPS will lose cookies silently; ok for deployed preview.
test_credentials: Admin mattsossi@bsossi.com / CoParents2026! (working). Fresh users created via /api/auth/register.
seed_data_creation: Test users prefixed 'test_' / 'ui_' / 'u1_' / 'u2_' with random hex; test cases created with child_name 'TEST_*'. Not cleaned up (no admin endpoint) but isolated to test accounts.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 8 assessment types verified end-to-end via demo path. IPV disclaimer wording, page titles differ per assessment_data.IPV_PAGE_TITLES — not deeply inspected on UI; recommend a UI check on page 1 disclaimer text for ipv type if design changes. Wizard: pressing load-demo-btn-a in step 3 skips filling names in step 2 (creates case with defaults) and redirects directly to /report/:id — that's by design per requirements. Print click is wired to window.print (verified button exists; print-container has exactly 10 .report-page children).
